title: Layer PR checks: writer cone records
derivedInputs: the main commit the records were taken at; each record is matched against the PR's reads by writer-cone.ts
consumers: record-writers on push (an incremental record starts from the newest one, #1702)
savePolicy: push only (RECORD_WRITERS env set only in record-writers)
verify: writer-cone.ts re-checks each recorded read before a writer is skipped
notes: Saved on every push to main (#1702): a full record once per writer-record-hours window, an incremental one otherwise, which carries each matching writer's record forward and traces only the rest.

stateInputs.how: not yet derived from a recorded read set; the producer may read state:mount graphs
